summary_for_children: Al-Ma'idah asks us to keep our promises, to help each other in goodness, and to be fair. It tells of Adam's two sons and of the table asked for by the disciples of Isa.
world_title: The Hall of the Spread Table
environment_concept: A hall of promises (5:1), an olive grove where a crow scratches the ground (5:31), one lantern that lights a whole hall (5:32) and a long table under an arch, spread and empty (5:114).
architecture_and_scenery: Covenant hall with carved pillars, a grove of tall trees, and a long table set under an arch.

palette.lighting: Late afternoon gold, cool grove shade
palette.atmosphere: Calm, with birdsong in the grove

areas.name: Hall of Contracts
areas.description: A hall where promises are written on pillars.

areas.name: Grove of the Crow
areas.description: A grove where a crow scratches the ground; read 5:31.

areas.name: Lantern of One Life
areas.description: A single lantern that lights a whole hall.

areas.name: Arch of the Table
areas.description: A long table under an arch, shown empty and lit; no people.

activities.name: Help each other
activities.description: Carry baskets of food to the hall to share.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Keep the promise
activities.description: Make a promise at the start of the world and keep it by finishing a task.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: The narrator distinguishes the Quran's account of the two sons from explanation and keeps the tone gentle.
learning_objectives: Retell the lesson of the crow
Understand that saving one life is precious

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (crow, hall, lantern, olives, table) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
